scope: Final production frontend build, existing lint ratchet, committed lockfile-only advisory query and existing documentation citation checker. No new application/runtime edits.

bundle_provenance.meaning: The production index and package manifest/lock hashes are unchanged by this final build. Browser screenshot/latency evidence and full test counts remain reported separately.

lint_limit: Existing lint ratchet passes at 8 warnings and 0 errors, with no baseline update or warning suppressions. This is debt containment rather than zero-warning whole-repository lint.

security.limit: Lockfile metadata query, no package install/fix/scripts. npm category counts overlap and are not summed; previous current-platform installed audit counts are different scopes.

citations.limit: Existing checker scope is docs/guide, guide/screen-map and MANUAL_PLAIN_ENGLISH. It checks citation resolution/ranges and conservative symbol anchors, not all documentation prose semantics.

independent_inference_review.scope: Read-only query_ollama local provider outcome and teardown review
independent_inference_review.outcome: Root-owned fix initializes error and promotes served only after natural provider completion, preserving queue release and fail-soft audit scheduling. A related bare async-for closure gap was reported with a stdlib reproducer and root applied the existing Scribe aclosing pattern before releasing the queue.
independent_inference_review.focused_tests: Owned and reported separately by root; not rerun or counted here.

limits: CPU-heavy build/lint checks began only after the lead agent released the real-model timing window.
No model/app network calls, package installations, live data reads or deployments were performed by these checks. npm queried the official advisory registry only.
No full frontend test or browser outcome is inferred from build/lint/advisory/citation checks. Their evidence is owned separately.
Hosted GitHub Actions were not run.
